qualification: Cold native common-caller replays use unchanged archived public returns. Every current command is computed before the host supplies its expected return. The unchanged historical comparator supplies the same 17 checks and check labels: commands, complete public-packet hashes, animation lengths, primitive boundaries, selected family/group/proposal kind/subquestion, named coordination entry/guard fields, prefix lengths, epoch anchors, source-series event counts, common-caller counters, natural level boundaries and final public result. Only fresh observation-session prefixes are normalized in the selected fields. Timings, implementation labels and migration-status labels are excluded. Complete provider payloads, derived identities, graph chains/revisions, full original-caller parity and equality of newly added family state are not asserted. Original payloads remain in the complete reports. These are recorded-return regressions, not new live game successes or a speed comparison. Legacy v53/v54 labels in the reused comparator identify its provenance; the case manifest and frozen source identify the actual baselines and current execution. This final summary consolidates the retained initial four strict passes and the isolated complete WEAV strict pass; see recovery for the unmodified initial failure and actual process configuration.

recovery.qualification: The first four completed passes are reused verbatim. WEAV retains the signal 9 interruption at 67 actions (cause unproven), the separate 768 MiB V8 heap exhaustion, and the later invocation whose execution handle disappeared without a retained final exit status or report. No cause is assigned to that incomplete invocation. The final host releases the full historical baseline before running the unchanged campaign harness and reloads it for the unchanged 17-check comparator only after the native process ends. Its raw log and heartbeat are persisted while it runs. All 17 original checks pass on the full 81-action replay. No trace, expected command, comparison tolerance, native source or test changed. No game clock restarts and the official timing runner/environment does not use this replay host.
